title: The detail of a strip-mode refusal
description: Builds the detail <file>:<line>:<col>: non-erasable TypeScript syntax (<construct>) or invalid TypeScript syntax (<message>) at the position nodePosition gives, counted in the file as committed; a withheld position carries the stderr line test-strength: column for <file>:<line> is node's display column (position check withheld: <reason>), whose reasons include node's caret does not move across the tie and the probes disagree.
